Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 13:12 -0400
Subject: POC trial: environment options, success criteria & owners (decision matrix)

Thanks again for taking the call today — good signal on scope and constraints. Quick recap + proposed execution plan so we can lock timelines.

Goal: 2-week technical evaluation to validate latency, cost/throughput, and functional quality for your chat summarization workload against a ~50k msg sample.

Environment options (high level):
- Hosted trial (Redwood hosted API): fastest to spin up (1 business day). Shared infra, supports prefix/KV caching, streaming, and basic token retention controls. Recommended if you want fast time-to-value and to iterate on prompts.
- Dedicated sandbox (reserved infra): isolated GPU pool we spin for you (3–7 business days). Predictable throughput and easier to stress-test sustained QPS.
- VPC trial (private control plane in your VPC): full network isolation and KMS integration (2–4 weeks depending on infra approval). Best for regulated data / strict residency.

Success criteria (proposed):
1) Latency: 95th percentile <= 300ms for 512-token sequences under target load (TBD qps).
2) Accuracy: F1 >= 0.78 on your labeled summarization holdout (we'll run eval harness).
3) Cost proxy: baseline tokens-per-minute and projected $/1k tokens under suggested batching config.
4) Reliability: <1% error rate, graceful fallback on model variant mismatch.

Evaluation plan & timeline (proposed):
- Day 0 (you): share sample corpus + target queries (see attached sample_data_instructions.md).
- Day 1: Hosted trial available (if chosen). Redwood runs baseline prompts, returns initial latency/cost numbers.
- Week 1: Iterations on prompt templates, caching config, and small-scale load test.
- Week 2: Ramp to target throughput, run automated evals and produce pass/fail on success criteria.

Owners / asks:
- BlueWave: deliver sample corpus, compliance constraints (PII handling), and preferred kickoff date.
- Redwood Sales (me): coordinate kickoff and procurement questions.
- Redwood Solutions (Marissa): environment setup + runbook for the trial.
- Redwood SRE/SE (Karthik): tuning (batching/quant) and throughput testing.
- Customer Success (Neha): define customer-facing success metrics and handoff for expansion.

Attachments: redwood_poc_mop.pdf (minimal ops plan), env_decision_matrix.xlsx (decision matrix + cost delta), sample_data_instructions.md.

Next step: can you confirm which environment you prefer for the initial run (Hosted / Dedicated sandbox / VPC) and a preferred kickoff date this week or next? If no constraint on data residency, our fastest path is Hosted so we can start Day 1.

--
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0184

Good questions — short answers: 
- Region: Hosted can be pinned to eu-west-1 for the trial (we'll ensure logging and model endpoints are in-region). For strict residency + KMS key ownership you should choose Dedicated sandbox or VPC (Dedicated supports customer-managed VPC peering and KMS in most cases).
- Dedicated sandbox: typical setup is 3–7 business days and we can provide a draft SOW and T&Cs for procurement. Trial costs are usually covered as a credit for evaluation; procurement requests vary by enterprise — I'll loop procurement if you want formal PO language.
- VPC trial: expect 2–4 weeks (depends on your infra approvals and our legal/compliance checklist).

Recommendation: If you want to validate ML quality and latency quickly, start with Hosted in eu-west-1 (Day 1). If your compliance team requires keys or network isolation before any data leaves your control, plan for Dedicated sandbox or VPC and we can start procurement/infra parallel work while we run synthetic tests.

Action: once you confirm region + environment, Marissa will schedule the setup and Karthik will provide an initial tuning config. I've attached the minimal ops plan and decision matrix to help the procurement conversation.

--
Rafael

Quick answers + runbook sketch below.

1) Hosted (eu-west-1)
- ETA: ~1 business day (we provision pinned endpoints and a scoped API key).
- Checklist: customer provides sample corpus + target qps, we create project, enable KV/prefix caching, share endpoint + test harness.
- Limitations: hosted uses Redwood-managed infra; logs/metrics stored in-region if requested but we do not ship KMS keys to the customer.

2) Dedicated sandbox
- ETA: 3–7 business days.
- Customer needs: CIDR for peering (optional), PO or SOW sign-off for reserved capacity (we can offer a short-term evaluation credit), primary infra contact for peering & KMS.
- Benefits: isolated GPU pool, predictable tail latency under sustained load.

3) VPC trial
- ETA: 2–4 weeks.
- Customer needs: infra-approved VPC, KMS key, security contact for firewall rules and peering, and an onboarding window for both teams to run networking tests.

Runbook (one-page summary for Liam):
Day 0: sample corpus + contact details from BlueWave (you).
Day 1: Hosted endpoint in eu-west-1 active (if chosen). Redwood runs baseline prompts, returns initial latency/cost. (Owner: Marissa)
Day 3: Prompt tuning + caching config applied; small-scale load test (Owner: Karthik)
Day 6: Midpoint check-in: automated evals (quality) + cost projection (Owner: Neha)
Day 9-10: Ramp to target throughput, stress test, and collect metrics (Owner: Karthik)
Day 12-14: Final report and go/no-go recommendation versus success criteria (Owner: Rafael / Neha)

I can draft the one-pager and attachment today. Karthik — can you add the recommended batch/quant settings for the 512-token summarization workload?

--
Marissa

Notes on tuning + ops: 
- Starter config for 512-token summarization: batching target = 8 concurrent requests, dynamic batching enabled, kv-prefix caching on top-5 tokens, model variant = rw-medium-2026 (float16) for initial quality checks.
- If latency > 350ms at 95p during ramp, recommend moving to Dedicated sandbox with larger GPU instances or enabling lower-precision quant path (we can test int8 path; quality delta expected ~1–3%).
- I will be the on-call SE for the trial (Slack: @karthik-rr; available 9am–5pm CET).
- For Dedicated: need an approximate qps target to right-size GPUs — Liam, can you give a target concurrency/throughput?

I'll attach a short tuning checklist to the runbook.

--
Karthik
